classification: static instruction bindings; native runtime acceptance recorded separately

boot.status: static candidates; require native guest validation
boot.rx_start_ready_semantics: After original RX task startup flags bit0 enabled GPIO IRQ58 via 0x40c15fec, before returning to task event wait; replaces wall-clock settle to avoid missed early MCU readiness.
boot.lens_request_callback_return_semantics: 0x41181504 is return from the original lens service send callback after supplied family4/type3 status. This boundary is not evidence of battery health or successful battery validation.

rx_retirement_semantics: rx_after_flag_clear is the shared API key; Z8 0x40c935d8 is after original GPIO ACK, not after notification flag-clear calls. Z8 clears RX state at 0x40c935d0 and calls GPIO ACK at 0x40c935d4; it omits the Z9 timer cancellation and flag4/2 clearing.

evidence.method: Unique full-file masked instruction windows, explicit control-flow recovery for RX, and original dispatch tables; no fixed-offset assumption.
evidence.masked_fields: branch relocation, ADR/ADRP, 64-bit MOVZ/MOVK address halves; register, opcode, memory offsets and 32-bit enum immediates retained
evidence.status_fields: body[0x1c]!=0 -> abstract payload+0x10 bit0; body[0x68] separately -> payload+0x24 enum; status callback event 0x03040002 replaces Z9 0x03060002
evidence.key_fields: body[7] half-press read at0x41020a48; body[0x43] menu read at0x41020b7c
